data.narrative:
Overland AI is a Series A defense and security company founded by Byron Boots, Greg Okopal, and Stephanie Bonk, with $40M+ raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 companies in the Defense & Security sector at same or adjacent stages, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy ($40M) and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, yields $80M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company cohort produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B; representative peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), and Code Metal ($1.2B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $540M. The wide dispersion—driven by heterogeneity in peer exit trajectories and funding environments within Defense & Security—reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation and product-market maturity. Stage-progression methodology produces a conservative floor; peer median anchors to later-stage comparables. Key uncertainties include Overland AI's traction relative to the peer set and the timing and terms of anticipated Series B activity.
